content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    谁都道，沐如岚宠着弟弟，却只有那对兄弟知道，沐如岚是宠他们，但是对他们并不放纵，甚至可以说有时候严厉的让他们害怕，害怕的是她会不要他们，也因此，所有人都管不住的双胞胎兄弟，只对这个姐姐惟命是从。
两个少年僵着背，似乎有委屈，跟耍小脾气似的，不回头看沐如岚一眼，而沐如岚也没去哄他们，坐回办公桌戴上眼镜专心的工作，时不时接个电话，指挥点什么，就像一个成功的女强人。
那声音很柔和，有种软软的挠得人有些心痒的感觉，听起来很舒服，即使是骂人也是软软的，前面背着沐如岚面壁的两个少年心里却十分不是滋味，拳头紧了又松松了又紧，时间一点一滴过去，沐如岚都没有要理他们的打算，于是，一向比较理智但还尚稚嫩的沐如霖动了。
他转过身走向沐如岚，带着伤口却依旧精致漂亮而尚带稚气的脸上，淡色的唇抿了抿，“姐，你别生气，我错了。”
那边沐如森心里大怒，沐如霖你个王八蛋！说好了这次要让姐姐来哄我们的！沐如森脾气比较冲，却又比较倔，真生气了他能跟你怄上几天几夜，可偏偏他就是不敢跟沐如岚太生气，他怕沐如岚不疼他了，怕沐如岚不喜欢他了，他更怕，自己的宠爱被双胞胎兄弟给抢走了。
所以，他也转身，大步的跑过去，而且直接跑到了沐如岚身边，抱住她的脖子，十五岁的美少年长得漂亮身材也好，都一米七了，他撒娇，“姐，对不起，别生气了，我们只是太生气了而已，姐姐！”
沐如霖站在办公桌对面，看着这一幕没说话，本来该戴着眼镜的眼眸有些暗，薄唇抿成一条线。
沐如岚被沐如森摇晃的有些头晕，不得不放下笔，看着两兄弟，“好，那你们说，人家蓝一阳转学过来才两天，怎么惹你们了，把人家打成这样？”
一提到那个转学生，沐如森脸色瞬间就臭了下来，“那个贱人……”
“嗯？”
沐如森连忙改口，“那个转学生很可恶！你都不知道，他竟然说……没什么，他就骂了我们几句。”沐如森想到了什么，委屈的看了沐如岚一眼，垂下脑袋闷闷的道。
沐如岚叹了口气，弯下腰从桌底下拿出医药箱，站起身蘸了药水，把沐如森的下巴抬起来，动作很流畅，却也是姐弟私底下才会做的，要不然不知道的还以为他们是情侣而非姐弟呢。
沐如森被这一抬，觉得心脏也跟着飞扬起来了，“姐……”
沐如岚让沐如森坐她的办公椅上去，比她小一岁的弟弟长得比她高，得这样擦起药才方便些，沐如岚一边给沐如森擦药，一边放柔了声音教训道：“光知道闹脾气，也不想想马上就要校庆了你们在学校里打架合适不合适，还把人打进了医院，还好没生命危险，要不然爸妈还不知道怎么教训你们呢……疼不疼？”
沐如森一听，平日里跟哥们打架冲前锋的少年立刻挤眉弄眼，“疼，疼死了，姐，我疼死了，快给吹吹。”
沐如岚顿时心疼的皱了皱眉，动作更轻柔了，顺便还轻轻的给他吹气。
沐如森仰着头看沐如岚，沐如岚低着头给他上药，沐如森觉得这样的角度看自家姐姐真的非常的美好，他姐姐老漂亮了，脾气又好，偶尔还很可爱，他时常想，自家姐姐一定要藏在家里一辈子，谁也别想娶她，谁敢跟他抢他就跟他拼命！她是他的。这样的想法，即使越长越大，除了越坚定之外竟然没有丝毫觉得不合适，要知道这是她亲姐。
可是就是他这么宝贝的姐姐，那个该死的转校生竟然敢意淫她，还敢光明正大的说想要跟她做！他和沐如霖刚好经过，一听到这句，立刻想都没想的扑过去把人揍了，他们当时都气啊，恨不得把蓝一阳给杀了！
沐如霖静静的站在办公桌外看着这一幕，心底有些不舒服，但是他习惯了隐忍，也比较冷静，只是今天这事，他没法冷静下来，听到蓝一阳那一句的瞬间，他就想杀了他了，他们家这么善良纯净的姐姐，不容一丁点儿的玷污！
“如霖，还不快过来。”沐如岚给沐如森上好了药，把沐如森赶走，沐如森不情不愿的站起身，还不忘瞪沐如霖一眼。

沐如霖当做没看到，脚步不假思索的便走了过来，坐下，紧抿的唇微松，嘴角柔和。忽的，他想到了什么，“姐，森恋爱了。”

content_en:

Everyone knows that Mu Rulan dotes on her younger brothers, but only the brothers know that Mu Rulan dotes on them, but does not indulge them. It can even be said that she is sometimes harsh and scares them. The fear is that she will not want them. Therefore, the twin brothers, who are beyond everyone's control, only obey the orders of this sister.
The two teenagers stiffened their backs, as if they were aggrieved, as if they were having a bad temper. They did not look back at Mu Rulan, and Mu Rulan did not try to coax them. She sat back at her desk, put on her glasses, and concentrated on her work. From time to time, she would answer the phone and give instructions, just like a successful strong woman.
The voice was very soft, with a soft ticklish feeling that made people feel itchy. It sounded very comfortable, even if it was a curse, it was soft. The two teenagers in front of them, who were facing the wall with Mu Rulan on their backs, felt very uncomfortable. Their fists tightened, loosened, and tightened. Time passed by, and Mu Rulan had no intention of paying attention to them, so Mu Rulin, who had always been relatively rational but still immature, moved.
He turned around and walked towards Mu Rulan, with his pale lips pursed on his wounded but still delicate, beautiful and childish face, "Sister, don't be angry, I was wrong."
Over there, Mu Rusen was furious, Mu Rulin, you bastard! We agreed that my sister would coax us this time! Mu Rusen has a hot temper, but he is also stubborn. If he is really angry, he can stay with you for days and nights, but he just doesn't dare to be too angry with Mu Rulan. He is afraid that Mu Rulan won't love him anymore, and that Mu Rulan won't like him. He is even more afraid that his favor will be taken away by his twin brother.
So, he turned around and ran over with long strides. He ran directly to Mu Rulan and hugged her neck. The fifteen-year-old beautiful boy was 1.7 meters tall with a beautiful figure and a good figure. He acted coquettishly and said, "Sister, I'm sorry, don't be angry. We are just too angry, sister!"
Mu Rulin stood opposite the desk, watching this scene without saying a word. His eyes that were supposed to be wearing glasses were a little dark, and his thin lips pursed into a thin line.
Mu Rulan was a little dizzy from being shaken by Mu Rusen, so she had to put down her pen and looked at the two brothers, "Okay, then tell me, it has only been two days since Lan Yiyang transferred to another school. Why did he offend you and beat him like this?"
As soon as the transfer student was mentioned, Mu Rushen's expression suddenly turned bad, "That bitch..."
"Huh?"
Mu Rusen quickly changed his words, "That transfer student is hateful! You don't even know that he actually said...it's nothing, so he scolded us a few times." Mu Rusen thought of something, glanced at Mu Rulan aggrievedly, lowered his head and said dully.
Mu Rulan sighed, bent down and took out the medical kit from under the table, stood up, dipped in the potion, and lifted Mu Rusen's chin. The movement was very smooth, but it was something that siblings would do in private. Otherwise, those who didn't know would think they were lovers instead of siblings.
Mu Rushen felt her heart soar as she was lifted up, "Sister..."
Mu Rulan asked Mu Rusen to sit on her office chair. Her brother, who was one year younger than her, was taller than her, so it was more convenient to apply the medicine this way. While applying the medicine to Mu Rusen, Mu Rulan softened her voice and lectured: "I only know how to lose my temper, and I don't want to think about whether it is appropriate for you to fight in school with the school anniversary coming soon. It also sent someone to the hospital. Fortunately, it is not life-threatening. Otherwise, your parents will not know how to teach you... Does it hurt?"
When Mu Rushen heard this, the boy who usually rushed forward in fights with his buddies immediately winked and said, "It hurts, it hurts so much, sister, it hurts so much, please blow me off."
Mu Rulan suddenly frowned in distress, her movements became gentler, and she blew him gently at the same time.
Mu Rusen raised his head to look at Mu Rulan, who lowered her head to apply medicine to him. Mu Rusen felt that it was really beautiful to see his sister from this angle. His sister was so beautiful and had a good temper.You are also very cute. He often thinks that his sister must be hidden at home for the rest of her life. No one can marry her. Anyone who dares to steal her will fight him to the death! She is his. This kind of thought, even as she grows older, does not feel inappropriate except for becoming more determined. You must know that this is her biological sister.
But for such a precious sister like him, that damn transfer student actually dared to lust after her and openly said that he wanted to have sex with her! He and Mu Rulin happened to pass by. When they heard this, they immediately rushed over and beat the person without thinking. They were so angry at the time that they wanted to kill Lan Yiyang!
Mu Rulin stood quietly outside the desk watching this scene, feeling a little uncomfortable in his heart, but he was used to being tolerant and relatively calm, but he couldn't calm down about this matter today. The moment he heard Lan Yiyang's words, he wanted to kill him. Such a kind and pure sister in their family cannot be tainted in the slightest!
"Rulin, come here quickly." Mu Rulan gave Mu Rusen the medicine and drove Mu Rusen away. Mu Rusen stood up reluctantly, not forgetting to glare at Mu Rulin.
Mu Rulin pretended not to notice, walked over without thinking, sat down, her tight lips relaxed slightly, and the corners of her mouth softened. Suddenly, he thought of something, "Sister, Sen is in love."
